split_policy: reused established ideal-pilot 5-fold assignment by original program; every variant/backend remains grouped
feature_policy: mutant code plus pre-run backend token; no program identifier, report output, or detection-rate value
label_policy: detected in at least half of report runs; each report is positive if any of its named tests has test_result=fail; retained target is empirical report outcome, not semantic bug correctness
limitations: extreme class imbalance for fake_brooklyn (one negative row)
seeded synthetic mutants are not real bug reports
backend comparisons are exploratory, not hardware fault attribution
